# Hammed Sefiu | Book Formatting

> Hammed Sefiu is a freelance book formatter based in Ibadan, Nigeria. He prepares print-ready PDF interiors (paperback and hardcover) and EPUB 3 ebooks for self-published authors on Amazon KDP and IngramSpark, and checks every file in KDP Print Previewer and Kindle Previewer before delivery.

## Services
- Paperback print interiors for Amazon KDP and IngramSpark
- KDP hardcover and IngramSpark case laminate interiors
- EPUB 3 ebook formatting (clickable TOC, heading styles, alt text; checked with Kindle Previewer and EPUBCheck)
- Workbook and guided journal interiors
- KDP rejection fixes (margins, bleed, trim, fonts, images)
- Upload support and series templates

## Key facts
- Genres: memoir, self-help, business and leadership, Christian nonfiction, novels, short stories, workbooks, guided journals
- Not offered: comics, manga, illustrated picture books, cover illustration, manuscript editing
- Turnaround: 3 to 5 days for books up to 60,000 words
- Pricing: fixed quote per book; hourly work at $22/hr; free sample chapter layout
- Guarantee: any KDP rejection of a file he formatted is fixed at no cost
- Response time: 0 to 4 hours
